ibd_note: data.cdc.gov has no IBD surveillance dataset comparable to Chronic Disease Indicators. Dataset hksd-2xuw includes arthritis. Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis trends in this monitor are ClinicalTrials.gov start counts and PubMed publication counts.
